newsitem.title: HUNGARY: MOL domestic offering to begin May 12.
newsitem.headline: MOL domestic offering to begin May 12.

text.p: A domestic public offering of at least 984,000 shares in Hungarian oil and gas company MOL will begin on May 12, the Hungarian MTI news agency said on Monday, quoting lead manager Creditanstalt Securities.
The 984,000 shares represent one percent of MOL's registered capital, and a further one percent will be added to the offering if there is sufficient demand, Creditanstalt said.
The subscription period will end on May 23, but the offering will be closed after three days if the stocks are oversubscribed, Creditanstalt added.
The subscription price of the shares will be announced on May 8, it said.
The domestic offering will follow an international offering of at least 12.5 percent of MOL's shares.
